about.title: About the project
about.lead: Blobus is an English trainer where you hold a live dialogue with an AI tutor instead of filling in blanks.
about.whyBody: Most apps put everyone through the same programme: the same lessons and the same mistakes nobody explains. Blobus builds a session around you — your level, your goal, your pace. The tutor keeps the context of the conversation, corrects as you go and explains the rule instead of just marking it red.
about.howBody: A thirty-question test first places your level on the CEFR scale. Then you pick a mode — conversation, grammar, interview prep or general English — and a tutor whose character suits you. Every session ends with a review: what worked and what to practise next.
about.note: The project is built by one developer. Support emails are read personally, and updates ship often and on point.

launch.title: The project starts
launch.body: Blobus is open. The sandbox runs the thirty-question level test, four learning modes, a listening check and error review inside the dialogue. Next: the server side, payments and voice mode.
